description: This Java class 'TriggerImage' generates images of trigger signals for rusEfi, reading trigger data from a text file, processing wave states, and rendering visual representations with Swing components.

classes.name: TriggerPanel
classes.description: Custom Swing JPanel subclass for displaying trigger information and graphics, with overridden paint method.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Helper class representing a signal with a value and an angle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes GUI and triggers image generation based on input folder.

methods.name: generateImages
methods.description: Reads trigger data from a file and processes each trigger to generate images.

methods.name: readTrigger
methods.description: Parses trigger data, creates wave states, and updates the GUI panel with generated images.

methods.name: readTrigger
methods.description: Reads trigger signals from BufferedReader, constructs wave states for visualization.

methods.name: angleToTime
methods.description: Converts an angle value to a time value (simple cast to int).

methods.name: formatTdcPosition
methods.description: Formats the TDC position for display, as integer if possible, otherwise as double.
